target_material: Al xTi yO z mixtures and Al 2O3 – TiO2 – Al 2O3 nanolaminates
summary: The study focuses on the electrical characterization of Al xTi yO z mixtures and Al 2O3 – TiO2 – Al 2O3 nanolaminates prepared by atomic layer deposition (ALD). The research aims to understand the conduction mechanisms and leakage currents in these materials, comparing them to pure Al 2O3 films. The study also investigates the impact of TiO2 content, layer thickness, and post-deposition annealing on the dielectric properties and performance of the films.
evidence: Mixtures and nanolaminates of Al 2O3 and TiO 2 with different alumina to titania ratios were prepared by atomic layer deposition. The studies were aimed at electrical characterization of metal-insulator-semiconductor capacitors formed by combining an insulating oxide with large band gap /H20849Al 2O3/H20850with an oxide with high dielectric permittivity /H20849TiO2/H20850. In mixtures, the ratio of Al 2O3 and TiO 2 growth cycles varied from 10:2 to 5:5 with target layer thickness in the range of 6.2–8.8 nm. In Al 2O3 –TiO 2 –Al2O3 nanolaminates, the thicknesses of Al 2O3 and TiO2 constituent layers were in the ranges of 3–6 and 2–15 nm, respectively.
